Technical SEO.title: Google Confirms Search Spam Team Is Fighting and Well Resourced
Technical SEO.summary: Google VP of Engineering Rajan Patel confirmed the search spam team remains well-resourced, citing the August 2026 spam update as a recent example of ongoing algorithmic action against spam in search results.

Technical SEO.title: Google Search Console AI Reports Rolled Out Worldwide
Technical SEO.summary: Google has globally rolled out Search Console reports tracking AI Overviews and AI Mode impressions, giving all site owners visibility into their generative AI search performance for the first time.

Technical SEO.title: Google: We Don't Penalize For Old Outbound Links With Shady Content
Technical SEO.summary: Google's John Mueller clarified that sites will not be penalized for outbound links pointing to domains that have since changed ownership and now host low-quality content, noting that web turmoil makes this a common scenario.

Technical SEO.title: Google European Search Dataset Licensing Program Details
Technical SEO.summary: Google, designated as a gatekeeper under the EU Digital Markets Act, has updated its European Search Dataset Licensing Program page, detailing how it will share search data with competing search engines to comply with the DMA's fair competition requirements.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: How We Earned 1,000+ Links For GEO/SEO
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Kevin Rowe outlines the digital PR system behind earning over 1,000 citations, detailing which types of data-driven stories attract journalist coverage and how research-based content wins placement in AI Overviews.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: ChatGPT Is Now a Very Large Online Search Engine In The EU
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: OpenAI reported approximately 159.1 million average monthly search recipients for ChatGPT, triggering its designation as a very large online search engine under the EU Digital Services Act and the regulatory obligations that come with it.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Claude Searches Web Differently From Claude Code, Data Shows
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: New data reveals that Claude and Claude Code search the web at different rates, mention different brands, and send their agents to different types of pages, with implications for how brands should think about AI crawler optimization.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google's Mueller Shares Their Experience With Markdown For AI SEO
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google's John Mueller shared firsthand findings from checking whether AI crawlers were actually requesting markdown versions of his sites, offering a practical data point for publishers weighing markdown delivery for AI bots.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: How To Restructure Your Marketing Team and Budget For The AI-Search Era
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The piece argues that three specific role changes and a budget rebalance can move a marketing team from invisible to cited in AI search results without requiring new headcount.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Rank Math SEO Plugin Pauses Controversial Feature and Says It Will Return
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Rank Math has temporarily disabled a controversial plugin feature after acknowledging a serious consent failure, while confirming the feature is planned to return in a future update.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google AI Mode With Inline Shopping Carousel Ads and Single Ad Unit
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google is now displaying shopping ads in an inline carousel format within AI Mode results and also showing an additional ad unit at the bottom of AI Mode, signaling an accelerating push to monetize the AI search surface.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google is dynamically expanding AI Overviews for some queries
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google is auto-expanding AI Overviews to a fuller AI Mode-style response for certain queries, pushing organic results further down the page and changing the competitive landscape for publishers.

AI Search / GEO.title: Daily Search Forum Recap: August 31, 2026
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google Search is making AI Overviews fully expanded for some queries, effectively making them behave like AI Mode responses and pushing standard organic results further down the page.

AI Search / GEO.title: Microsoft Forcing Copilot Users To Login But Not For Copilot Search Answers
AI Search / GEO.summary: Microsoft now requires users to sign in before accessing Copilot directly, though this login requirement does not currently apply to Copilot Search answers surfaced within Bing Search results.
